questions.prompt: Which organelle is the main site of aerobic respiration?
questions.explanation: Aerobic respiration primarily occurs in mitochondria.

questions.prompt: Which factor most directly contributed to the outbreak of World War I in July 1914?
choices: The assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand
questions.explanation: The assassination triggered the July Crisis and the chain of declarations of war.

questions.prompt: What happens to the oxidation number of a species when it is oxidised?
questions.explanation: Oxidation is loss of electrons, so oxidation number increases.
